text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A 70 cm square picnic mat. A headlamp. A 
wristwatch with a compass. A lap blanket 
for the cold. A tumbler filled with a warm 
drink.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...And a small, pale blue cushion whose 
texture I've grown somewhat fond of."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave my smartphone behind. I don't 
need anything noisy. Nor anything too 
glaring.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Because I'm going there to talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, the night pass was approved. 
Heheh, it's such a help how Ayabe is 
always so meticulous with paperwork!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, make sure not to stay out too 
late. Don't let your guard down just 
because you're used to it, okay?”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it. Well then... have a 
wonderful night of stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hello—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Ayabe-san, are you going stargazing 
tonight!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Phooey, and after I finally found such an 
ultra-fluffy video, too... Oh."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Could tonight be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Don't wait up for me like last time, go 
to sleep first. You can turn off the 
lights in the room, too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —The new moon.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
On that night, which comes around roughly 
once every 30 days, the stars shine with 
their most dazzling brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"A special time where I can feel her... my 
sister, even closer than usual."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
On the night of the new moon, I shall come 
to converse with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Something I've kept doing ever since I was 
a little kid who knew nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Ever since learning that I had lost you, 
it has been a habit I have never broken, 
not even once.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Aah... I knew it.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Tonight, I feel you just a little bit 
closer—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...The date of my debut was decided, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Finally, starting from here. I will run in 
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And so... for the life you couldn't live, 
for the races you wanted to run, even for 
everything I took away from you—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because I will run.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll run, I'll win, and I'll dedicate the 
glory to you. So... just wait for me a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Keep your eyes on your big sis, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(――...I will win. I'll win, keep winning, 
and dedicate countless crowns, the highest 
honors, all of it.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My life burns for that very purpose. Only 
for that, and nothing else—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, just in case... ...A report? 
...A report.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've got a Trainer now. Because it's 
necessary... in order to make my debut...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What an enigmatic person.

Some time has passed since I became Admire 
Vega's Trainer and we began earnest 
training for her Debut race.

With incredible talent inherited from her 
mother, a stoic mindset, and the sharp wit 
to grasp instructions instantly, her 
training was progressing remarkably 
smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah... haah. Whew—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Skip the praise. What are the next 
orders?

...Since she thoroughly rejects any 
unwanted meddling, it still feels like 
there's quite a distance between our 
hearts.

"Even so, this shouldn't be resolved by 
force. First, until Admire Vega comes to 
see me as someone worthy of trust—"
choice_data_list:
(I need to make sure I put in the effort 
myself.)

(I have to make sure I put in the effort 
myself.)

text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why there is one thing 
that must be done first—"

That was something I realized after 
training with Admire Vega all this time. 
She was—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, reducing the strain on the legs 
caused by skeletal misalignment... is that 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, when I watched Admire Vega run 
earlier, I was also a little concerned 
about the tilt in her posture...
choice_data_list:
It seems my left leg has been slightly 
crooked since birth...

text_block_list.text:
A skeletal distortion that appeared to be 
congenital. It also affected her everyday 
posture, ultimately putting extra strain 
on her legs.

Also, according to the documents received 
beforehand, the skin on the soles of her 
hooves seems slightly thinner than 
average.

Being serious and highly independent, she 
takes good care of herself day-to-day, and 
no major problems have arisen, but...
choice_data_list:
I wanted to lighten your load, even if 
only a little.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As your Trainer, I think that's a 
wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything at all I can do to 
help, please don't hesitate to ask!

The daily care is sufficient. If that is 
the case, I would like to propose 
improvements at a more fundamental level.

After discussing it with Tazuna for a 
while, the conclusion we reached was—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"It seems making improvements to the 
horseshoes would be the best way to 
compensate after all."
choice_data_list:
Like getting custom-made horseshoes 
tailored to your build!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Um, so, I have a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Why not try consulting with Admire Vega's 
mother?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, her mother 
struggled with the same issue during her 
active racing days... She might know a 
good solution.

Admire Vega's guardian contact info was 
listed in her file. I called and explained 
the situation as thoroughly as possible. 
Then—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—The farrier who used to look after me is 
still accepting custom orders."

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"From what you've described, it would be 
best to ask that person... I'll go ahead 
and coordinate with them on my end."

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"No... Because this is pretty much all I 
can do for her."

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Um, Trainer. It might be presumptuous of 
me to say this, but..."

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Please... watch over that girl 
carefully."
And with that—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: New shoes and custom-made horseshoes?
choice_data_list:
I had it custom-made to suit your 
constitution.

I had it custom-made to suit your body 
type.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ............When did that even happen...

She took it while murmuring in confusion, 
and after a few light test runs to get a 
feel for it, I had her run at full power 
once.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hmph—!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The ground is so soft! My legs... feel so 
light...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah......

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It was easy to run in.

Tapping the ground with her toes as if 
testing the feel of it, the expressions 
she showed me were still nothing but 
stiff.

"Even so, while slowly building a bond of 
trust, let us run through the races 
together...!"

Yes, that was what they swore from the 
bottom of their heart.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I still don't really understand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's nothing.
